tools.description: Check whether a Bitcoin/Ordinals inscription mint can be funded SAFELY before anything is signed. An inscription is an ordinary sat in an ordinary UTXO, so naive coin selection will spend a six-figure inscription as fee-paying change and burn it to the miner, with no revert. This excludes inscription-bearing, rune-bearing and unproven outpoints BEFORE selection, prices the commit output (which must fund the reveal exactly, because the reveal has no other input), and refuses a payload too heavy to relay. Reports how many UTXOs were withheld, so a wallet that looks funded but is locked in inscriptions explains itself. Read-only.

contentBytes.description: Inscription payload size. Witness data, so charged at a quarter weight.

satIndexAvailable.description: Whether a sat index backs the annotation. Without it rare sats cannot be excluded and the result says so.

satVb.description: Target fee rate in sat/vB. Use bitcoin_mint_fee_rate for the live marginal rate.

tools.description: Explain why the EVM arm-then-fire mint model does not port to Solana, with the real numbers. Covers: a signed transaction dies in ~60s because recent_blockhash is inside the signed message, so pre-signing ahead of a trigger is impossible; Solana has no nonce, so a re-signed retry can land ALONGSIDE the original and mint twice; and every minter writes the same candy machine account, capping a collection at roughly 12,000,000 CU per block network-wide no matter how many wallets are used. Read-only.

computeUnitsPerMint.description: CU per mint, to compute the per-block ceiling for the collection.

tools.name: solana_mint_constraints

tools.description: Plan what a Solana mint attempt will cost, using LIVE getRecentPrioritizationFees samples for the collection's own writable accounts rather than any hardcoded figure. Requires the writable accounts, because querying without them returns the global per-slot minimum (usually zero) and tells you nothing about a contested mint. Reports that the fee is charged even when the mint LOSES. Read-only: builds no transaction and signs nothing.

computeUnitLimit.description: Measured CU limit from a simulation. Do NOT pad it: an inflated limit raises the scheduler's cost denominator and LOWERS priority at the same spend.

percentile.description: Percentile of observed fees to bid, 0-100. Default 75.

signatureCount.description: Default 2 — Candy Machine mintV1 needs a fresh ephemeral asset signer.

writableAccounts.description: The transaction's hot writable accounts, e.g. the candy machine address.
